Welcome to NanoBrew Café! Customers come in and sit down; your servers bring them whatever is ready on the nearest counter. Your job: keep the food coming and turn your happiest customers into Synth staff.
Click a stove and pick a dish to cook. A server carries the finished batch to a free counter.
Your server carries dishes from the counter to the tables. After eating, customers pay your Cashier at the register.
That customer is glowing — they loved it! Click them while they pay or walk out to spend your NanoBrew: they become a Synth.
Click one of your Synths to see its card — then click a stove, counter, register or the Pod bay to give it that job.
The café is closed: it's night. Plan for tomorrow here, then press End Night.
Open Night Ops, pick a MegaBean café and a squad, then Plan raid. Raids bring Nano Cores (for NanoBrew) and Influence.
Press End Night to see the night play out.
That's the basics! Take over the Alley by beating its flagship. Good luck.

Clerkbot: a fast, steady server, but slows down late in the shift.
Bulkform: strong with a big battery — great raider, but clumsy: sometimes drops dishes.
Glitchling: cooks very fast as a chef, but glitches now and then.
Hypeform: a Cashier whose appeal brings more customers, but works slowly.
Steady-unit: good at anything and barely uses battery, but slow.
Xeno: a strong chef that unlocks Star Jelly, but needs special fuel (recharging costs 3× Power).
Night Owl: works faster late in the shift instead of slower, +3 power in fights.
Perfectionist: dishes it serves make customers happier (+10), but it works 15% slower.
Chatty: dishes it serves earn bigger tips (+30%) and it greets a little, but works 10% slower.
Kleptomaniac: brings back 30% more raid loot, but may pocket 10 coins at night.

Power is how hard this Synth hits in raids and defending the café. Power = species base × (1 + 15% per level above 1) + trait bonus (Night Owl +3). Each hit deals power × battery (×0.5 below 20%, nothing when empty) × a random 0.8–1.2. Bases: Clerkbot 6, Bulkform 14, Glitchling 8, Hypeform 5, Steady-unit 7, Xeno 10.

Speed doesn't matter in fights: raiders always strike first, then the sides take turns.
Speed: how fast a Server carries dishes and batches, and how fast a Cashier takes payments. 1.0 is normal; +15% per level.
Cooking: as Chef, added to its own stove's cooking speed (+60% makes it 1.6× faster); +15% per level.
Appeal: as Cashier, customers arrive more often (+50% means 1.5× as many). Several Cashiers add up.
Power: damage per hit in raids and when defending the café. Grows 15% per level; low battery halves it.
HP: how much damage a Synth takes before it's knocked out of a fight. +15% per level; Security adds HP at home.
Battery: drains every second on duty. Below 20% a Synth works and fights at half strength; at 0 it stops. Max battery is rolled per unit (70–200). Recharged at night with Energy.
Level: XP comes from work (deliveries, batches, payments, greeting) and fights. Each level raises the stats that grow.

Cooking: click a stove and pick any dish. Click a cooking stove to cancel its batch (full refund) or swap it for another dish. Servers carry finished batches to a free counter, then bring each seated customer the dish on the counter nearest them — that is what they pay for.
Jobs: click a worker, then a place — a stove (Chef), a counter, table or bin (Server), a register (Cashier) or the Pod bay (Rest). Click another worker to switch; click empty floor to close the card.

Converting: a customer who loved their meal glows. Click them while they pay or walk out, or pick them from the Ready to convert list at the top left, to spend NanoBrew: they become a Synth. They stay convertible until the café closes.
Quests: daily quests, the story and achievements. Today's dailies are listed at the top left — claim a finished one right there, or anything from the Quests button.
Shop: furniture, décor, café upgrades, Energy and the Workshop, open any time while the café keeps running. Buy & place puts the piece in your hand; Store keeps it for later (place it from Arrange).
Arrange: Move, rotate, place and sell furniture and décor — any time. Pieces in use (a cooking stove, a counter with food, an occupied seat) can be moved but not picked up.
Bag: everything you own — equipment, fashion and EXP bottles. Take a piece off before selling it.

Resources: Coins pay for dishes, upgrades and décor. NanoBrew converts a glowing customer. Nano Cores (from raids) brew NanoBrew. Energy recharges Synths' batteries at night (2 coins each). Suspicion brings MegaBean raids — and at 90, a Corporate Audit. Influence unlocks the district's flagship.
Auto: each night passes by itself — no raid, batteries recharged with the Energy you have. It stops for a Corporate Audit, and MegaBean raids on the café still play out. It unlocks on day 3.
Windows: drag a worker's Details window by its title to move it. Click the pencil on a worker's card to rename it.
